privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: Choose what you share. Decide stays free and complete either way.
privacy.contributionBody: Anonymous queue samples that improve wait estimates. Active sharing means fewer ads.
privacy.adsBody: Allow ads tailored to your trips instead of generic ones.
privacy.analyticsBody: Help us understand which screens work. No precise location leaves your device.
privacy.revocationNote: You can revoke any of these anytime; the change applies immediately and ads return to default. We never sell personal trails.
